title: appointment.requested v1
description: Logical event contract for Process 01. LOGICAL envelope is kept separate from PHYSICAL database columns. appointment_id is the correlation identifier. No patient_id. No scheduled_start. preferred_date is NOT part of this event. Recipients are NEVER supplied by the browser; resolved server-side.

event_id.description: Unique event id. Local V1: deterministic UUIDv5; production outbox: generated once, persisted.

source.description: Physical origin; separate from logical envelope.

source_id.description: appointments.id (bigint identity), serialized as string. appointment-row-id.

appointment_id.description: appointments.id serialized as string. Correlation identifier. NOT patient_id.
